The finite-state squared-jump formula counts each SSEP bond and has the N^-d gradient bound. Equal occupations and constant G give zero jumps, and t=0 has zero bracket. Exact current Statement scope: Assume the Axiom of Choice. Let $d\ge1$, $N\ge3$, $T\ge0$, and let $(\eta_t)_{0\le t\le T}$ be the SSEP from the diffusive-model definition with any initial probability vector. For a real smooth periodic $G:\mathbb T^d\to\mathbb R$, set

$$M_t^{N,G}:=\langle\pi_t^N,G\rangle-\langle\pi_0^N,G\rangle-\int_0^t\langle\pi_s^N,\Delta_NG\rangle\,ds.$$

Then $M^{N,G}$ is a square-integrable martingale. Its continuous predictable bracket is

$$A_t^{N,G}=N^{2-2d}\int_0^t\sum_{i=1}^d\sum_{x\in\Lambda_N}(\eta_{x+e_i}(s)-\eta_x(s))^2\bigl(G((x+e_i)/N)-G(x/N)\bigr)^2\,ds,$$

in the continuous predictable compensator convention of the finite-chain martingale supplier. In particular,

$$A_T^{N,G}\le T N^{-d}\sum_{i=1}^d\|\partial_iG\|_\infty^2.$$. Root adopts and binds this actual semantic disposition to the current item and row; this is not independent proof acceptance.
